draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: T1.r1.lat=41 (Corvex A2, fp16) and T1.r2.lat=118 (Corvex A1, fp32) support the numbers. The hedge "may" is appropriate because latencies were measured on different accelerators/precisions, so a direct speed comparison is not fully controlled. The claim is appropriately scoped and hedged.
